objective: Preregister 18 candidates (12 PAIR_* + 6 STATIC5050_* placebo controls) -- rotation_cell's cross-sectional momentum rotation mechanism reused unedited at menu size 2 / top_n=1, applied to six highly correlated ETF pairs, for a batch screening lane (built separately) to test against K1/K2 and the STATIC5050 counter-evidence downgrade rule. No backtest is run in this round.

keep_rule.K1: date-neutral Sharpe (median over monthly rebalance offsets) >= 0.80 * S3's date-neutral Sharpe in BOTH windows (anchor >=1.19, stress >=0.65), 10bp per side, positive CAGR at 20bp.
keep_rule.K2: a 63-session trailing-inverse-vol monthly blend of the candidate with S3 beats a vol-matched k*S3+(1-k)*SHY control by >=0.05 Sharpe in BOTH windows.
keep_rule.watch_recent: anchor-window Sharpe >= 1.19 but stress window does not clear its bar -- forward-tracked only.
keep_rule.strong_keep: K2 edge >= 0.10 in both windows, or K1's Sharpe in both windows >= S3's own (1.49 anchor / 0.81 stress).
keep_rule.counter_evidence_downgrade: A PAIR pass is downgraded to 'not kept (no switching increment)' if it does not beat its paired STATIC5050 candidate's judged Sharpe in every window it passed on.
keep_rule.multiple_comparisons: 18 candidates; DSR with n_trials=18 for any PAIR candidate that passes K1 or K2.
